claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Ipidacrine is a weak acetylcholinesterase inhibitor (IC50 ~270 nM) with no described cytotoxic mechanism; at 2.5 uM it is expected to produce little or no cell killing in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
